evidence.section: 3.7 Evolution of texture distribution
evidence.quote: When the temperature rose to 1400 C, the DRX ratio of Mo-Re-ZrO2, Mo-Re-ZrC, and Mo-Re-Ti3AlC2 alloys was smaller than that of Mo-Re alloys, which is due to the obvious Zener pinning effect produced by the dispersed second phase particles, which inhibited the grain boundary migration and the growth of recrystallized nuclei, and delaying the occurrence of DRX
